2) Audit window & evidence: we are proposing an "operator witness" option in lieu of full code escrow — limited witness sessions and a snapshot transfer protocol. Need to confirm schedule (we're targeting an audit window in Q2).

Team / Levi —

I've reviewed Levi's redlines and put together a short summary + our counterpoints (attached). High level:

- License scope: We are comfortable with customer-operated private deployments where the customer retains data residency; however, Redwood needs to maintain remote diagnostic capabilities and limited operator access for emergency debugging (we propose a scoped, time-limited SAS token model with explicit audit logging).

- Evidence & witness alternative: We can offer a certified "witness" protocol and a scheduled snapshot transfer for customers who cannot accept escrow. Conditions we need: (a) a mutually agreed runbook and checklist, (b) an NDA addendum for third-party witnesses if required, (c) restrictions on proprietary code/materials excluded from the evidence set.

- Audit window: Sequel's proposed Q2 window is fine; request a 2–3 week lead to coordinate on Redwood's side for internal ops and legal prep. For the witness session itself, we would limit access to an operator console read-only view with streamed logs and a curated snapshot transfer.

Next steps (action items):
1) Redwood legal to return consolidated MSA + Order Form redlines (tracked) by end of day Thu 30 Mar.
2) Connor to prepare a draft witness runbook and evidence inventory by Mon 3 Apr.
3) Rachel to confirm Sequel availability for Apr 11–18.

Attachments: Ancillary-Exhibits-Summary.xlsx (summary of exhibits and proposed exclusions), Redwood_MSA_Counterpoints_v1.docx (tracked)

Laura Bennett

Thanks — this all looks workable. We prefer the witness/certification pathway over full escrow if Redwood can commit to the following small clarifications:

- A written statement certifying Redwood staff who run the witness are employees (no contractors) and a short attestation that the snapshot was produced under supervision.
- A short SLA window for scheduling the witness session (Sequel will provide 3 preferred dates and Redwood should commit to a single confirmed date within 10 business days).
- Confirmation of evidence exclusions (PII and third-party licensed components) which Sequel accepts as withheld.

Sana will send preferred dates this afternoon. If Redwood returns the consolidated tracked redlines today as Laura suggested we can get procurement moving next week.

Appreciate the quick coordination.
